review.description: S1/S3 scheduled synchronization, credential failure recovery and later item discovery retain their contracts. Automatic review remains an explicit owner policy even with a simpler execution default.
review.implementation: Polling, GitHub budgets and review-request eligibility are unchanged. Automatic review preparation now uses the prompt-only native session when no mode was selected, while its claim and active-slot policy remain intact.
review.tests: Reviewed TestScheduledSyncRecoversCredentialsAndFindsNewItems and TestAutomaticReviewPreservesProfileSkills, including the new default-prompt case. Mapped suites rerun; no live GitHub or installed-host observation is claimed.
